summary: Security update for the Linux Kernel
details:
The SUSE Linux Enterprise 15 SP7 RT kernel was updated to fix the following issue:


This fixes the DirtyFrag issues:

- CVE-2026-43284: xfrm: esp: avoid in-place decrypt on shared skb frags (bsc#1264449).
- CVE-2026-43500: rxrpc and afs modules are disabled (bsc#1264450)
